question: Does v6 KC-to-MBON11 plasticity change arena survival relative to an arm receiving identical damage-triggered PPL101 stimulation with frozen weights?
matched: Fresh neural state at launch in both arms (no pilot checkpoint reused)
Same Doom seed 41027, combat_survival arena, fixed BCI decoder, calibrated v6 brain
Same damage-to-PPL101 stimulation rule; only weight updates differ
Same host and software; both arms run the native observer mirror
primary_outcome: Survival length (game tics) of each completed round, compared between arms in consecutive blocks of 50 completed rounds
secondary_outcomes: Training-arm weight change (changed edges, mean efficacy) over brain time
comparison_rule: Compare arms at equal round index and equal brain time. A learning-like effect requires training-arm survival to exceed control in later blocks, not only a within-arm trend. Early rounds are expected to be similar.
limits: One seed and one reconstructed brain: a single pair cannot establish biological learning
Game outcomes diverge after the first differing action, so rounds are not paired one-to-one
Interrupted rounds after a restart are censored by the server and excluded
v6 previously failed visual, conditioning and survival validation gates
pilot: outputs/doom/local-pilot-20260911 (unmatched training-only run, excluded from this comparison)
